profile.reading: Per fifteenfortyseven Critical Systems Realty own site, this Orangeburg, New York facility (ORNY1) sits on a 23 acre site less than 1 mile from the New Jersey border and about 22 miles from Midtown Manhattan. It totals 232,000 square feet with planned expansion to 462,000 square feet. The page states 24 MW provisioned in an N plus 2 scheme with 12 MW on site and an on site substation capable of supporting 50 MW total; because the on site current figure (12 MW) and the provisioned target (24 MW) are both mentioned without a single unambiguous current operating critical IT load number, this is recorded as a capacity note rather than critical_it_mw. High density cabinets of 10kW plus are supported, with access to 12 network providers.
profile.capacity_note: 24 MW provisioned (N+2 scheme) per operator site, with 12 MW on-site today and substation capacity for up to 50 MW total; figures not unambiguous enough to adopt as a single current critical_it_mw value
